title: Can Buy Now, Pay Later Hurt Your Credit Score?
summary: Short explainer noting that heavier BNPL reporting to credit bureaus means missed payments increasingly affect credit scores.

assertions.quote: Klarna, Afterpay, and Affirm all report missed payments
missed payments can be sent to collections and collections accounts do hurt your credit scores
heavy buy now pay later use is linked to borrowers dealing with even bigger debt

verdicts.note: Consistent with CFPB and Federal Reserve findings that heavier buy now pay later use correlates with other debt and financial strain.
CFPB finds BNPL borrowers generally held higher balances on other unsecured debt (cards, personal and student loans) than non-borrowers, and that credit-card utilization rose before first BNPL use.
FEDS Notes table 5: BNPL users average far more credit inquiries (1.30 vs 0.67) and delinquent trades (1.82 vs 0.54) than non-users.
